column1: # steps.tsv -- the step table run_v3.sh executes (one row per step, in chain order; TAB-separated).
# Edit this file, not run_v3.sh, to plug in a new script, change a heap or add a step.
#  step           id used in provenance/<tag>/<site>/<step>.json, logs and --steps/--force/--rerun-from
#  passes         I = islets, C = cells, S = structure objects, J = context + exports; X/R = reviewed-islet export/import for
#                 HiPerGator's pass J. A step may belong to several passes (preflight: I,C).
#  script         path relative to the project repo root. 'a|b' = candidates: --script-set v3 (default)
#                 requires the first, orig takes the last, auto the first that exists.
#  args           script arguments, '|'-separated; placeholders {OUT} {TMP} {TAG} {PROJ} {STEP} and {CFG}
#                 (the attempt's step_config.json: qpdata stat at the start, deadline...); '-' = none
#  save           self-saves (the script saves itself: script 0) | footer-saves (the generated footer
#                 saves only if the postcondition passed) | never (read-only; the footer checks the
#                 .qpdata did not change)
#  lane           gpu | cpu | light -- which slot pool the step waits for (--lanes-gpu/-cpu/-light)
#  heap_gb        JVM cap (-Xmx); also what the step reserves from the --mem-budget (a step with a post
#                 hook reserves at least the DuckDB memory limit + 8 GB)
#  threads        java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.parallelism (parallelStream users)
#  timeout_min    wall-clock limit; a killed step writes no sentinel and counts as failed. The footer
#                 starts no save later than --save-margin-min before it. SLURM --time must exceed the
#                 sum over a job's steps (v3ctl.py budget; hpg_submit.sh computes it).
#  after          steps that must be done AND older; re-running one of them makes this step stale.
#                 'x?' = only if x has run on this image (R_import exists only on HiPerGator).
#  needs          steps that must be done, in any order (re-running them does not invalidate this)
#  on_external    stale = an accepted external edit (--accept-external, e.g. the gate-1 GUI review)
#                 makes this step re-run, because it reads the edited image; keep = the edit IS the
#                 review of this step's output, re-running would overwrite it (use --rerun-from STEP
#                 when an edit does invalidate it, e.g. detections edited by hand: --rerun-from 2)
#  overrides      NAME=VALUE;... rewrites the declaration '<type> NAME = ...' in the script copy
#                 (must match exactly once, or the step is refused)
#  postcondition  footer check: name(key=v1|v2;key2=v) -- see footer_template.groovy
#  post           v3ctl.py post hook run after a passing step: cells_parquet | context_parquet | -
